import numpy as np

@zk_circuit
def kernel(alpha: Float, A: Float[Array, 'N<=1024 M<=1024'], B: Float[Array, 'N<=1024 M<=1024']):
    for i in range(B.shape[0]):
        for j in range(B.shape[1]):
            B[i, j] += np.dot(A[i + 1:, i], B[i + 1:, j])
    B *= alpha
